responsibility: This file provides the SPARC target’s C-family preprocessor and builtin-macro hook. Its sparc_target_macros routine defines the standard sparc macro, asserts the active machine/cpu form for 32-bit versus 64-bit compilation, and publishes the selected VIS ISA level through __VIS__/__VIS__ numeric macros, so front ends and headers can conditionally compile for the exact SPARC architecture features chosen by backend target flags.
